listing.name: Metroid Prime Remastered — Switch edition (MetroidPrimeRemasteredRecomp)
listing.summary: The Windows player for Metroid Prime Remastered imports your own version 1.0.0 Switch game. The project reports manual play from the opening Frigate into early Tallon and Chozo Ruins. Vertical controller aim is broken, and some loads can crash.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Select the base game at version 1.0.0 and provide prod.keys and title.keys where required. The launcher lists NSP, XCI, NSZ and XCZ inputs. Its format checks used synthetic data. Updates are unsupported.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use the Windows x64 release ZIP on Windows 10 version 1903 or later, or Windows 11, with Vulkan 1.3. The project tested an RTX 3080. It has not established support for AMD, Intel or other desktop systems.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: Loading all 275 areas was a separate test. The project has not confirmed full gameplay, physical controllers, HDR or exclusive fullscreen. Its release instructions do not say whether translated game code is included.
